$comment: Graphicus-ready contract, version 1. Semanticus grades and fixes a model to this file; Graphicus reads the same facts and does not re-check figures (W2, D5). Change only by a new version.

facts.rule: Every visible measure has a Description that Jev scores 70 or higher (Matches).
Every visible table has a Description.
Visible fields carry synonyms for the words the team uses; the team profile maps team words to measures.
AI instructions exist and stay under 10,000 characters.
Helper fields are excluded from the AI data schema.
The model has a marked date table.

facts.required: when a P&L is in the model
facts.rule: Each P&L measure has a unique line number (10, 20, 30 and so on); lower numbers show first.
1 means the line adds to profit; -1 means it takes from profit.
Each P&L line names its role.

facts.storage: annotation graphicus.funnel.order (each stage measure) or graphicus.funnel.stages (the stage column)
facts.valueType: integer stage number, or a JSON array of the stage values in order
facts.required: when a funnel stage column is in the model
facts.rule: Funnel stages have an order: a stage number on each stage measure, or the list of values on the one stage column.

facts.valueType: target.of: the exact name of the actual measure; target.kind: enum
facts.required: when a budget, target or forecast measure exists
facts.rule: A budget, target or forecast measure names the actual measure it compares to (for example on Budget Amount: Net Sales) and its kind. The named measure must exist.

notAnnotated.what: team-named measures (for example Net Revenue and Gross Bookings)
notAnnotated.why: Separate measures with Descriptions and synonyms; the team profile (W3) maps the team's word to the measure.
Power BI service only on live models: no TOM or XMLA writer. Semanticus reads them from a PBIP folder (VerifiedAnswers/definitions) but does not write them in v1.
